steps.title: Establish Project Metadata and Schema
steps.description: Configure app metadata, package name, and define the local calculation logic schema.

steps.title: Configure Build System
steps.description: Set up Gradle with correct Android SDK versions and Java 8 compatibility, ensuring no external dependencies.

steps.title: Define Application Manifest
steps.description: Configure AndroidManifest.xml for the new app, including activity setup and theme.

steps.title: Define Color Palette
steps.description: Establish a consistent color scheme for the application UI elements.

steps.title: Define String Resources
steps.description: Add all user-facing text strings for the Daily Planner app.

steps.title: Create Reusable Drawable Backgrounds
steps.description: Design custom XML drawables for elevated cards, primary buttons, and input fields to ensure a consistent UI.

steps.title: Design Main Activity Layout
steps.description: Construct the user interface for adding tasks, displaying tasks, and showing completion progress.

steps.title: Implement Task Item Layout
steps.description: Create a layout for individual task items within the task list.

steps.title: Develop Main Activity Logic
steps.description: Implement Java code for task management (add, delete, mark complete), local storage, and progress calculation.

steps.title: Create Custom Task Adapter
steps.description: Develop a custom ArrayAdapter to efficiently display and manage task items in the ListView.

steps.title: Synchronize Asset Metadata
steps.description: Ensure runtime assets match application identification.

steps.title: Building Daily Planner
steps.description: Execute Gradle assembleDebug to produce production-ready APK.
